stop_criteria.name: finger_joint_error_far_beyond_old_servo
stop_criteria.note: DIRECT PHYSICAL, both arms. The field: per full stats record, the mean over the 8 bodies' model steps of the record's window of the mean over the 44 finger hinges of |hinge angle - that hinge's joint goal| at the model step's last physics step, degrees (0 = every hinge on its goal; env.py hand_joint_error_deg, train_mimo.py hand_control). The line: the hour mean above 15.0 degrees from run-hour 0.5. Production's servo and calibration (the control arm's configuration) read window means 14.26 to 14.41 degrees in control runs C1 and C2 and the cap arm L from 481,800 (model steps 482,100 to 484,600, 26 records each), per-record spread 0.38 to 0.45, hour means 14.03 to 14.59 from run-hour 0.25 in those runs and seg41o_1431. Simulated with the watcher's own rule at the highest level and spread (m2_stop_line_rates.json, 20,000 runs each): this line stops a run of production's configuration in 1.0 to 3.1 of 1,000 runs (the repair-run proposal's 14.6 from run-hour 0.25: 457 to 537 of 1,000), a run 1 degree worse than production's in 1,000 of 1,000 and 0.5 degree worse in 665 to 740 of 1,000, and a run at the paired trace's size for the finger servo read as this field reads it, after every model step (13.8 to 14.0 degrees: the highest window mean less the 0.43 to 0.64 degree the servo removes, analysis/m7_sc1_reach_and_sc2b_error.json; read at the hold's end only it removes 1.17 to 1.38), in 0 of 1,000. WHAT A STOP MEANS (the same words wherever the comparison states it): A stop of either arm, on any line, ends the comparison without a verdict: matched_comparison_verdict.py reads INVALID and the other arm is not launched. A finger-arm stop on the finger joint error line is in addition recorded as a finding against the package (the finger hinges ended farther from their goals than the line allows, the failure the package exists to remove); every other stop is recorded as readings only, neither a pass nor a fail of the package.

stop_criteria.name: non_finite_update
stop_criteria.note: INTEGRITY, both arms. The field: the model steps of the record's window whose live loss was not finite (train_mimo.py). Any such model step in the hour stops the run (a non-finite update changes every learned weight it reaches). 0 in every full stats record of seg41o_1431, C1, C2 and L. The watcher's 5-minute check also stops on nan_steps above 0 in the newest record, and the standing watches' line M2 on the trainer log's skipped optimizer updates; this entry is the registry's record of the same line. EVERY PROGRAM THAT CAN WRITE A STOP INTO AN ARM'S FOLDER WHILE IT RUNS (read on Oct 9, 2026 from each program's code and the running processes; the same programs, files and lines for both arms, and launch_state.py hashes each program's files at both launches; what any of these stops means is the first entry's note; matched_comparison_verdict.py counts a stop from any of them: stop_reason.json, or a control_done_*.json or pending control.json whose cmd is stop or snapshot_and_stop without auto_resume). (1) The hourly watcher, docs/h84_launch_2026-09-18/hourly_watch.py, started by the arm's supervisor; it writes stop_reason.json, then snapshot_and_stop. Its lines: the six entries of this list, read from the run folder's declared_criteria.json; and its own rules, none an entry here: nan_steps above 0 in the newest record; a stop field non-finite in the newest record or absent from an hour of records; the planner monitor (a selection that worsens a body's total score, comparison scores missing, a non-finite search, or a hand stage reporting another calibration than the admitted fit fe953beb... in the control arm or the recorded replacement f68754c8... in the finger arm); a layer under 50 of 100 units responding in two complete report windows after the liveness repair's own window (efference.lesson.vision_in and efference.lesson.body_mlp.0 are alerts only); free disk under 8 GB on the stats, checkpoint or caregiver-record drive, or commit room under 4 GB; and its hourly rules, each needing two consecutive hourly window means past its line: vision causal error above 2 times, tactile causal error above 3 times, replay loss above 3 times and model steps per second under one third of this run's hour-1 mean, which judge from the second hourly sweep, so their earliest stop is the third sweep, about 10,200 s after the watcher finds the first record, while C1, C2 and L ended 6,631 to 7,851 s after their start (the independent review of Oct 9, 2026); vision or tactile token variance under 0.15, judged from run-hour 3; and follow_bout under -0.038, which read 0.246 to 0.293 in the four runs that review read. The five rule files it loads by path: motor_asked_change_watch.py (the asked-change watch, through the first full report at or past model step 484,875: its switch record M1, non-finite updates M2, its hidden layer under 0.9 live share in 2 full reports M3, the other senses against their level before its switch M4, the step rate under 0.9 of the window before in two windows running M5, its output above its growth line M6) and heads_all_slot_path_watch.py (the all-slot paths watch, through model step 489,350: M1, M2, M3 read as an alert for a run that resumes 481,800 of seg41o_1431 with max_steps 484675 (hourly_watch.CAP_EXPERIMENT_LATER_ARMS), M4, M5, a path's output above its sense's real change M6, a path's fixed vector against the old head's M9, proprioception's own-command reading M7, a head's audited error M8) judge both arms; proprio_repair_watch.py, vestibular_repair_watch.py and vestibular_input_path_watch.py judge only runs their switch records reach and printed no line in C1's, C2's and L's watcher logs. (2) The self-percept watch, docs/gain_of_function_v4/coordinator/self_percept_watch_loop.py with Source/Python/mimo_bridge/tools/self_percept_watch.py (processes 7876 and 30248, running since Oct 3, 2026 12:07 PM PDT): every 300 s it judges the supervisor's active run when that run's args.json reads self_percept_release on, as both arms' commands do, and on a crossed line it pauses the supervisor and writes stop_reason.json and snapshot_and_stop. Its two stop lines, declared here as stop lines of both arms: 2 or more live model steps above the self-percept limit of 8 within any 1,000 model steps since the resume, and more than 25 perceive calls above that limit per 100 model steps in a report. C1, C2 and L read 0 such model steps and at most 1 such call per 100 model steps over their 2,875 model steps (Saved/gof_takeover_20260927/self_percept_watch/loop.log). (3) The persistent memory watch, docs/gain_of_function_v4/coordinator/memory_watch_loop.py, which runs docs/gain_of_function_v4/persistent_memory_deploy_watch.py --act every 300 s (processes 6516 and 20176, running since Oct 1, 2026 8:46 AM PDT); it writes snapshot_and_stop into the active run's control.json and no stop_reason.json. Its stop lines (K2: a body-to-body or over-the-window state spread under 0.08 in a full report from the second through 10,000 model steps after the memory's switch; K4: a sense's log of its median ratio over the median of the 20 full reports before the switch above its line, over full reports 2 to 21 after the switch; K5: the step rate over those reports under its line) cannot fire on an arm: the switch it judges is the record of part switch at model step 415,075 (a resume writes part loaded, which it skips), so K2 reads reports up to model step 425,075 and K4 and K5 the reports 2 to 21 after 415,075, all in the arms' common ancestry before 481,800, and an arm adds no record any of them reads; on those reports it reads no crossing (K4: vision -0.380, tactile -0.007, audio 0.013, proprioception -0.012 against the lines 0.944, 0.028, 0.052 and 0.014; K5: 0.891 against 0.862; Saved/gof_takeover_20260927/memory_watch/verdict.json, 4:31 AM PDT, Oct 9, 2026). It could write a stop only if its code, its lines file docs/gain_of_function_v3/measurements/persistent_memory_resume_lines_2026-09-25.json or those records changed. (4) The relaunch script itself (relaunch_h84_seg41_2026-09-29.py stop_trainer) writes snapshot_and_stop with its reason into the new run's control.json when no supervisor attaches after the trainer starts: a failed launch, not a line. No stop for an arm comes from the ability scheduler (ability_rechecks.py and ability_comparison_window.py) or the pause runner (run_in_training_pause.py): each refuses to write into a run's control.json while supervisor_control.json holds a pause (training_continuation.pause_reason), and it holds the repair run's pause while an arm runs. The observer, the archiver, the dashboard and the explainer builder write no control.json.

stop_criteria.name: vision_cost_beyond_cap_line
stop_criteria.note: PREDICTION, both arms; a sense the package does not reach (the camera images the eyes receive). The field: vision's prediction error over the error of predicting no change on the record's live transitions, body 2 left out (0 = exact, 1 = no better than 'nothing changes'). The line: hour mean above 940 in 1,000 from run-hour 1.25; the cap experiment's line unchanged (row attention_cap_stop_lines_481800).
